user.title: Connect to an Access Point
user.description: Access Points are normally found automatically. Add one by address only if it cannot be discovered, for example on a separate VLAN.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Access Point.

discovery_confirm.title: Add Access Point
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Access Point {name} at {host}?

reconfigure.title: Change Access Point address
reconfigure.description: Point this entry at a different address. It must still be the same physical Access Point.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add tag
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add the tag {name} ({address})?

abort.already_configured: This Access Point is already configured
abort.wrong_ap: That address belongs to a different Access Point. Add it as a new entry instead.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not an OpenEPaperLink tag

data_description.blacklisted_tags: Tags to hide; no entities are created for them.
data_description.button_debounce: Ignore repeated button events within this window. The Access Point repeats a wake-up reason on every check-in.
data_description.nfc_debounce: Ignore repeated NFC scans within this window.

ap_cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the Access Point at {host}: {error}.

ap_command_failed.message: The Access Point rejected the command: {error}.

tag_command_failed.message: The Access Point rejected the command for this tag: {error}.

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is not in an allowed directory. Add it to allowlist_external_dirs in your configuration.

unknown_tag_type.message: The Access Point has no tag type definition for {mac}, so its display size is unknown.

no_led_segments.message: No LED colour groups were enabled; set a flash count above zero for at least one.

image_size_mismatch.message: The image for tag {mac} does not match the size its display expects, so the Access Point would render it as noise: {error}

atc_not_in_range.message: The tag {address} is not currently reachable over Bluetooth. These tags sleep between advertisements, so it may simply not be awake yet.

atc_failed.message: Could not draw on the tag {address} over Bluetooth: {error}

drawcustom.name: Draw custom image
drawcustom.description: Draws an image built from a list of elements on one or more tags.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: The elements to draw, in order. See the documentation for the available element types and their options.

background.name: Background colour
background.description: Colour to fill the display with before drawing.

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.description: Degrees to rotate the finished image. Applied before sending, so the payload can be laid out sideways for a tag mounted that way. The tag's own configured rotation still applies on top of it.

dither.name: Dithering
dither.description: Algorithm used to reduce the image to the colours the tag can actually show. Ordered suits flat graphics; the error-diffusion algorithms suit photographs.

refresh_type.name: Refresh type
refresh_type.description: How the tag redraws. Adaptive uses quick refreshes and does one full refresh a night to clear ghosting, which is much easier on the battery than refreshing fully every time.

ttl.name: Time to live
ttl.description: How long the tag sleeps before checking in again. Applies once, after this update. A long value means you cannot update the tag again until it elapses.

dry-run.name: Dry run
dry-run.description: Render the image and show it on the tag's image entity without sending it to the tag.

setled.name: Set LED pattern
setled.description: Flashes the LED on tags that have one. Up to three colour groups play in turn, and the whole pattern repeats.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Flash the pattern, or stop a running one.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: How long the LED stays on within each flash. Higher is brighter and uses more battery.

repeats.name: Repeats
repeats.description: How many times the whole pattern plays.

flash_speed1.name: Flash speed 1
flash_speed1.description: Length of each flash in the first group.

flash_count1.name: Flash count 1
flash_count1.description: How many times the first group flashes. Zero skips the group.

flash_speed2.name: Flash speed 2
flash_speed2.description: Length of each flash in the second group.

flash_count2.name: Flash count 2
flash_count2.description: How many times the second group flashes. Zero skips the group.

flash_speed3.name: Flash speed 3
flash_speed3.description: Length of each flash in the third group.

flash_count3.name: Flash count 3
flash_count3.description: How many times the third group flashes. Zero skips the group.

clear_pending.name: Clear pending update
clear_pending.description: Discards an update the tag has not collected yet.

force_refresh.name: Force refresh
force_refresh.description: Makes the tag redraw its current image.

scan_channels.name: Scan channels
scan_channels.description: Makes the tag search the radio channels again for an Access Point.

refresh_tag_types.name: Refresh tag types
refresh_tag_types.description: Reloads tag hardware definitions from the Access Point. Useful after it downloads one it did not previously hold.
